source.label: FY2026 Form 20-F, Note 7 Income tax expenses, cash paid for income tax
source.quote: Composition of cash paid for income tax, net of refunds received The composition of cash paid for income tax, net of refunds received for the year ended March 31, 2026 is as follows: Year ended March 31, 2026 RMB (in millions) Chinese mainland 30,729 Non-Chinese mainland 3,284 34,013

notes: Taxes: us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaidNet, cash paid for income tax net of refunds received (Chinese mainland 30,729, non-Chinese mainland 3,284, RMB millions). R&D not reported as a separate line. Alibaba reports 'Product development expenses' (RMB66,533 million for FY2026); the 20-F says they consist primarily of staff costs and share-based compensation for research and development personnel and other costs of developing new technologies and products, but it does not say the line is R&D, so it is not recorded under the 'only if the filing says it is R&D' rule.
